complaints.originalDescription: The main road connecting Sector 14 to metro station has 4 very deep potholes. Two scooter riders fell yesterday.
complaints.professionalTitle: Request for Urgent Road Surface Repair & Pothole Rectification on Metro Approach Road
complaints.professionalDescription:
To the Concerned Executive Engineer, Roads & Public Infrastructure:

I am writing to formally submit a community civic grievance regarding dangerous road craters along the Sector 14 Metro Station approach corridor. Deep potholes pose imminent hazard to two-wheeler commuters.

Immediate mechanized road resurfacing and cold-mix patch filling are urgently petitioned.
complaints.priorityReason: Priority Score 82/100: Category weight (25pts), 42 community votes (38pts), pending duration 4d (10pts), urgency factor (10pts).
complaints.authorityRemarks: Inspected on 11th Oct. Tender issued for asphalt road-patching.

complaints.originalDescription: Huge pile of garbage accumulated outside public park entrance since last Friday. Stray dogs scattering waste everywhere.
complaints.professionalTitle: Civic Grievance: Immediate Removal of Accumulated Solid Waste Outside Children Park
complaints.professionalDescription:
To the Health & Sanitation Officer:

This petition highlights hazardous accumulation of uncollected municipal solid waste adjacent to the southern gate of Green Valley Children Park. Immediate dumper collection is required.
complaints.location: Gate No. 2, Green Valley Public Park
complaints.priorityReason: Priority Score 78/100: Category weight (20pts), 35 community votes (36pts), urgency factor (14pts).
complaints.authorityRemarks: Assigned to Ward Sanitation Inspector for dump-truck clearance drive.

complaints.originalDescription: Three streetlights along our residential lane have stopped working. Entire block is pitch dark.
complaints.professionalTitle: Notice of Inoperative Street Lighting Creating Public Safety Vulnerability
complaints.professionalDescription:
To the Electrical Engineering Department:

We formally submit a request regarding consecutive non-functional streetlights along 5th Cross Lane. Night darkness presents public safety risk.
complaints.priorityReason: Priority Score 65/100: Category weight (30pts), 18 community votes (25pts), urgency factor (5pts).

complaints.originalDescription: Drinking water pipeline joint broke under footpath. Thousands of liters of water wasted.
complaints.professionalTitle: Urgent Redressal: Main Potable Water Supply Pipeline Fracture & Severe Wastage
complaints.professionalDescription:
To the Water Supply & Sewerage Board:

Major rupture in underground potable water mainline. Outflow is flooding the street and wasting treated municipal water.
complaints.location: In front of Post Office Footpath, MG Road
complaints.priorityReason: Priority Score 88/100: Category weight (22pts), 52 community votes (41pts), urgency factor (25pts).

complaints.originalDescription: Stormwater drain overflowing behind community hall.
complaints.professionalTitle: Formal Redressal for Desilting & Overflow Prevention in Stormwater Drain
complaints.professionalDescription:
To the Municipal Drainage Division:

Silt buildup in primary canal behind community hall. Suction and desilting requested.
complaints.location: Rear perimeter of Community Hall, Block B
complaints.authorityRemarks: Super Sucker machine deployed. Drain completely desilted.
complaints.resolutionNotes: Suction and desilting operations completed successfully by Drainage Sub-division 2.
